events.text: Peter Skene Ogden and his Snake River brigade of beaver trappers were the first Euro-Americans to note the City of Rocks.

events.quote: In 1826 , Peter Skene Ogden and his Snake River brigade of beaver trappers were the first Euro-Americans to note the City of Rocks .

events.text: The area was ignored until 1843, when growing streams of wagons began flowing through the area in the summer.
